Composition API: isRef().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { isRef } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Check if the given value is a ref.

Composition API: unref().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { unref } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Unwraps a ref object and returns its value.

Composition API: toRef().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { toRef } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Creates a ref for a property on a source reactive object; a third argument supplies a default value.
The value / getter normalizing overload — `toRef(getter)` — is Vue 3.3+ only.

Composition API: toRefs().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { toRefs } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Converts a reactive object into a plain object where each property is a ref, so it stays reactive after destructuring.

Composition API: isProxy().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { isProxy } from 'vue'`).
Checks if an object is a proxy created by `reactive()`, `readonly()`, `shallowReactive()` or `shallowReadonly()`.

Composition API: isReactive().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { isReactive } from 'vue'`).
Checks if an object is a proxy created by `reactive()`or `shallowReactive()`.

Composition API: isReadonly().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { isReadonly } from 'vue'`).
Checks whether the passed value is a readonly object. The properties of a readonly object can change, but they can't be assigned directly via the passed object.
The proxies created by `readonly()` and `shallowReadonly()` are both considered readonly, as is a `computed()` ref without a set function.

Composition API: isShallow().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { isShallow } from 'vue'`).
Checks whether the passed value is a shallow proxy created by `shallowReactive()` or `shallowReadonly()`, or a `shallowRef()`.

Composition API: toValue().description:
**Vue 3.3+ only — not available in Vue 2.7 or @vue/composition-api.**
In Vue 2, use `unref()` and call getters yourself.
Normalizes values / refs / getters to values. This is similar to `unref()`, except that it also normalizes getters: if the argument is a getter, it will be invoked and its return value will be returned.
